texts.zh: 随着最后一艘敌舰停止运转，观测分析子例程汇报了一件怪事。这些入侵者的舰船外观与[Root.GetName]在多年前已经停止生产的型号别无二致。而且，这些舰船也不具有超光速引擎，武器也相对老旧。汇报尚未结束时，一道通讯请求信号从怪异的裂口中发出，响彻了整个星系。这个信号使用的竟是我们最高级别的信号交换协议……不过是10年前的版本。
texts.en: As the last corvette is rendered inoperable, observation analysis subroutines report something abnormal. The invader ships are similar to outdated vessels that the [Root.GetName] stopped producing years ago. Additionally, the ships lack FTL drives and are equipped with obsolete weaponry. While the report is coming in, a communication request originating from the strange tear reverberates throughout the system. It's using our most complex handshaking protocols... from 10 years ago.

texts.zh: 随着最后一艘敌舰被击毁，一个运转传感器的工蜂汇报了一件怪事。这些舰船的外观与[Root.GetName]在多年前已经停用的型号别无二致。同时这些舰船也不具有超光速引擎，武器也相对老旧。汇报尚未结束时，一道通讯请求信号从怪异的裂口中发出，响彻了整个星系。它是一个主脑不熟悉的、另一个[Root.GetSpeciesName]意识。
texts.en: As the last corvette falls, a drone manning the sensors reports something curious. These ships are very similar to outdated vessels that the [Root.GetName] stopped using years ago. The ships are lacking FTL drives and are equipped with obsolete weaponry. While the report is coming in, a communication request originating from the strange tear reverberates throughout the system. It's something this Mind is unfamiliar with, another [Root.GetSpeciesName] intelligence.

texts.zh: 随着最后一艘敌舰被击毁，在我们恒星基地内一位操作探测器的尉官汇报了一件怪事。这些舰船的外观与[Root.GetName]在多年前已经停用的型号别无二致。同时这些舰船也不具有超光速引擎，武器也相对老旧。汇报尚未结束时，一道通讯请求信号从怪异的裂口中发出，响彻了整个星系。这个信号使用的竟是我们最高级别的编码……不过是10年前的版本。
texts.en: As the last corvette falls, an ensign manning the sensors of our starbase reports something curious. These ships are very similar to outdated vessels that the [Root.GetName] stopped using years ago. The ships are lacking FTL drives and are equipped with obsolete weaponry. While the report is coming in, a communication request originating from the strange tear reverberates throughout the system. It's using our highest clearance codes... from 10 years ago.

texts.zh:
随着通讯画面闪烁显现，一串身份识别码被传来。校验和错误：这是[cloned_physicist.GetName]的专属ID！
“你好[Root.GetName]-阿尔法，很抱歉：此前的敌意行为是由[Root.GetName]-贝塔系统中冗余失效的分支军事机构导致的。它已被处理并删除。陈述：我们没有进一步敌意行动的意图。”
texts.en:
As the comms screen flickers on, an identification code is sent through. Checksum error: This is [cloned_physicist.GetName]s unique ID! 
"Greetings [Root.GetName]-Alpha and apologies: Previous hostile action was caused by a redundant and deprecated military branch of [Root.GetName]-Beta systems. It has since been dealt with and deleted. Statement: We intend no further hostile interactions."

texts.zh: 随着通讯画面闪烁显现，另一个意识的通讯工蜂拥有与[cloned_physicist.GetName]相同的意识结构。怪异。“你好[Root.GetName]-阿尔法，很抱歉。此前对你们发起攻击的工蜂是一些托管于独立设备过久的反常子个体。对于你们将其清除干净，[Root.GetName]-贝塔表示非常感谢。我们没有进一步负面行动的意图，愿意提出一些对我们意识双方均有利的提案。”
texts.en: As the comms screen flickers on the other Mind communication drone has an identical structure as [cloned_physicist.GetName]. Curious. "Greetings [Root.GetName]-Alpha and apologies. The drones that attacked you were deviants left to their own devices too long. [Root.GetName]-Beta appreciates that you exterminated them. We desire no more negative interactions and want to propose something beneficial for both our minds."

texts.zh: 随着通讯画面一同闪烁显现那张面孔在[Root.GetSpeciesName]看来是前所未见地疲惫、欣喜而又惶恐。[cloned_physicist.GetHeShe]看起来太眼熟了，简直就是[cloned_physicist.GetName]老了20岁的翻版。“呃……你好[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-阿尔法，我是[cloned_physicist.GetName]-贝塔”他停顿了一下，回了回神。“我，唔，我们……我们对刚才发生的意外非常抱歉。希望你们能理解，我们星球的防御集体中有一小撮冥顽不灵分子认为他们可以通过武力来夺取[Root.GetHomeWorldName]。我知道我的解释听起来像是狡辩，但请相信我，我们真的没有恶意。”
texts.en: As the comms screen flickers on, what looks to be the most exhausted, elated, and simultaneously terrified [Root.GetSpeciesName] imaginable appears. They look familiar, a dead ringer for [cloned_physicist.GetName] if [cloned_physicist.GetHeShe] had aged 20 years. "Ah... hello [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Alpha, this is [cloned_physicist.GetName]-Beta" they stop to gather themselves. "I, uh, we... We are terribly sorry for what just transpired. You have to understand, that was a rogue and defunct element of our world's defense collective thinking they could seize [Root.GetHomeWorldName] by force. I know the words might sound empty, but please believe me when I say that we have no ill intention towards you."

label.zh: 为什么你们好像没有超光速能力？
label.en: Why do you seem to be lacking FTL capabilities?

label.zh: 阐明缺失超光速系统原因！
为什么你们好像没有超光速能力？
label.en: Why do you seem to be lacking FTL capabilities?

label.zh: 别废话了。你们想要什么？
label.en: Enough talk. What do you want?

label.zh: 别废话了！阐明你的请求！

texts.zh: 我们已经建成了运输船，请求转移所有[Root.GetName]-贝塔之中的单位，并保全我们的资源与数据库，希望我们对浩瀚星宇的征程不会就此止步。
texts.en: Transportation ships have been built. Request to send over [Root.GetName]-Beta units to preserve resources and databanks. We do not wish to end our exploration of the universe here.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]-贝塔岌岌可危，而我们对此束手无策。我们为了这一天已经建造了巨型的运输船，并会尽可能输送我们的子个体。
此外我们还希望能够融入你们的蜂巢意识。尽管诞生之初你我并无不同，但是随着时间推移，我们的经历与见闻也成为了无法割舍的东西。请让我们一同共存吧。
texts.en:
[Root.GetName]-Beta's universe is doomed. There is no way to get around that. We have been building giant transport ships for this very day and would offer any drones we could send.
Additionally we wish to merge hiveminds. While identical at first this collective has had experiences and insights we don't want to lose. Please let us live on.

texts.zh: 我们的宇宙岌岌可危。而我们对此束手无策。我们为了这一天已经建造了巨型的运输船，恳求你们接纳我们的难民。只有最聪明和最优秀的领袖才有资格登上这艘船。请救救我的……我们的文明。
texts.en: Our universe is doomed. There is no way to get around that. We have been building giant transport ships for this day and implore you to let us send over refugees. Only our brightest and most capable leaders will fit on these ships. Please save my- OUR civilization.

label.en: This Mind needs to reflect on this request.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]控制下所有的超级计算机一齐运转，试图计算出关于当前[Root.GetName]-贝塔两难处境的最佳解决方案。最终，4个选项被认定可行。

1：研究贝塔宇宙的崩塌。
2：进入传送门并夺取一切有价值的矿物与能源储备。
3：通过科学单元：[cloned_physicist.GetName]-贝塔的提议。
4：想办法利用高度试验性的贝塔世界科学技术，将[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔带入阿尔法宇宙。
texts.en:
Every supercomputer under the control of [Root.GetName] was put on calculating the most optimal solution to the current dilemma regarding [Root.GetName]-Beta. In the end, 4 potential options were declared viable.

1: Study collapse of Beta universe.
2: Enter gateway and acquire all relevant stockpiles of minerals and energy.
3: Allow science unit: [cloned_physicist.GetName]-Beta's proposal.
4: Attempt to use highly experimental Beta science and technology to bring [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta into Alpha reality.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]全力思考如何决定[Root.GetName]-贝塔的命运后，4个潜在选线被给出。

1：研究贝塔宇宙的崩塌。
2：进入传送门并夺取一切有价值的矿物与能源储备。
3：接受[Root.GetName]-贝塔的请求，接纳孪生意识。
4：想办法利用高度试验性的贝塔世界科学技术，将[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔带入阿尔法宇宙，合并孪生意识。
texts.en:
As the full might of [Root.GetSpeciesName]'s intelligence was put on the task of deciding the fate of [Root.GetName]-Beta 4 main potential solutions were proposed.

1: Study collapse of the Beta universe.
2: Enter the gateway and acquire all relevant stockpiles of minerals and energy.
3: Accept [Root.GetName]-Beta request and subsume the other Mind.
4: Attempt to use highly experimental Beta science and technology to bring [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta into Alpha reality merging Minds.

texts.zh:
各领域的杰出人才在[Root.GetName]上汇聚一堂，决定我们的异次元孪生文明的终极命运。在[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上发生了无数激烈而艰难的论战。有的人建议不要干涉，研究一个宇宙的消亡一定能收获颇丰。也有说法称应该接受[cloned_physicist.GetName]-贝塔的请求，尽可能多地撤离那颗行星上的人们。还有人提到趁机将他们留在星球上的有价值的资源及能量储存搜刮一空简直易如反掌。

随着峰会议论氛围的逐渐缓和，[cloned_physicist.GetName]走上讲台，[cloned_physicist.GetHeShe]宣称使用贝塔宇宙带来的新科技，应该有机会将整个[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔带到我们的现实中。
texts.en:
A summit of the top minds from every field gathered on [Root.GetName] to discuss the fate of our dimensional twins. Harsh and difficult debates were had throughout [Root.GetHomeWorldName]. Some suggested a hands-off approach. Studying the end of a universe could be very insightful. There was talk about granting [cloned_physicist.GetName]-Beta's request to evacuate as much of the planet as possible while some mentioned how easy it would be to take whatever precious resources and energy stores the planet had left.

Just as the summit was winding down, [cloned_physicist.GetName] took center stage and declared that [cloned_physicist.GetHeShe] believed that using the new technologies brought from the beta universe, there was a chance to bring the entirety of [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta into our reality.

label.zh: 实现事业的单位增加了！
